sentences: This is my Downloads folder.
Somewhere in here is last January's electricity bill.
It's called document, five, dot P D F. Of course it is.
This is Dewey. It reads your documents, so you don't have to remember what you called them.

scenes.headline: One tap files a whole folder
bullets: The whole sort can be undone
scenes.record: Documents tab with the corpus folder linked. Tap Sort, let the progress run, then show the new folders and the review queue. End on the Undo button.
sentences: I point it at a folder and tap Sort.
Dewey reads every P D F, in French, Arabic or English, even scans with no text in them.
It works out what each one is, creates the folders, and files them. Bills, bank statements, contracts, medical letters.
Anything it isn't sure about goes to a review queue instead of being guessed.
And the whole sort can be undone with one tap.
All of that happened on the phone. Sorting sends nothing, anywhere.
On our test set of a hundred documents, it filed ninety-seven, and got every single one right.

scenes.headline: Ask your documents
bullets: Answers from what's in your files
scenes.record: Open the assistant, type 'When is my Lydec bill due and how much is it?', wait for the answer with its source chips, tap one. Then a quick pass over the Bills tab.
sentences: Then I can just ask. When is my Lydec bill due, and how much is it?
It answers from what's actually in my files, and shows exactly which documents it used.
Bills get their own tab, sorted by what's due first.

scenes.headline: Librarian runs on RevenueCat
scenes.record: Fresh install (or signed-out Test Store user). Tap the locked Documents tab, show the paywall prices, buy the annual plan through the Test Store dialog, land on the unlocked tab. Then Me tab: sign in with email, open 'Help with my subscription'.
sentences: The part that reads for you is Librarian, the paid tier, and it runs on RevenueCat.
The paywall is our own design, but every price on it comes live from the RevenueCat offering, and the savings badge is worked out from the real products.
One purchase, the entitlement flips, and everything unlocks.
Sign in, and RevenueCat logs the purchase in to your account, so it follows you to a new phone. And RevenueCat's Customer Center handles restores and cancellations right inside the app.
Under the hood, that's configure, a customer info listener, offerings, purchase, restore, log in, and Customer Center.

scenes.headline: A real scanner and fourteen PDF tools
bullets: Scan with edge detection and OCR
scenes.record: Home: tap Scan and capture a page. Then Reorder: long-press a page thumbnail and drag it. Then Sign: draw a signature and place it on a page.
sentences: And the free part isn't a teaser.
A real document scanner, and fourteen P D F tools. Drag pages into order, sign, split, merge, compress, add a password.
No ads, and no account needed.
Dewey. It finds the file you can't name.
